The updated `cli.mjs` prints the `--json` output with `JSON.stringify` of an array whose objects have the keys `file` and `bytes`.
The updated `cli.mjs` does not import `ink` or `react`.
The updated `cli.mjs` contains no terminal escape sequence such as `[?1049h` or `[2J`.
The updated `cli.mjs` registers no `resize` listener.
